No logs on SCB (
Y2 / R9 313202799027)
On SCC charger is with different serial number (
Y2/ R8 313202799027).
On SCC we can see the latest events, but we can't see the charger logs.
I'm in contact with the one of the member of SCC team to know if we can fetch the logs from SCC

1. Issue Customer reported:
Charger only provide 5kW
2. Suspected Root Cause
: n/a (There is no logs on SCB)
3. Action Performed (L2) :
n/a
4. Charger SW Version:
a. v3.2.8
5. Reason for Handover (L3)
: Suspect, config file is corrupted.
- The charger is connected to both SCB and SCC.
- On SCB, it is with Y2 / R9 313202799027, and on SCC with Y2 / R8 313202799027.
- The charger is online on both SCB and SCC.
- On SCB, there are no logs. I also checked CloudWatch for the last 12 months, but no logs were found.
- On SCC, there is no option to check the logs yet, but only getting Connectivity Update events.
- I reboot the charger from SCB. During the reboot, I observed the "PerformingCollaboratedReboot" alarm and other error flags. The main charger page also showed that SCB was disconnected. However, no logs were generated.
- I discussed this issue with a colleague from the SiFinity team, if SCC and SCB connection at the same time can affect this, as I encountered a similar issue earlier with different charger.
- After consulting with an expert, we suspect the issue might be due to a corrupted config file.
6. Action Required:
a. Action by HQ :
check with R&D if restore config is possible remotely.

additional_info.subject: 0390923 - ID0390923-DC/Si-D/MC-[cQ2bqX]- Charger only provide 5kW CRM:00472000239
additional_info.body:
Dear Yan Spano,
We observed an issue with charger connections to Siemens Backend that was not possible to receive the logs from the charger. It's fixed now.
Checking the last days sessions I didn't saw any charging session with power limitation. The Smart Charging profile was deleted and most probably was the reason for your low power charging sessions.
Can you share the timestamp when you noticed the behaviour? Or we can also organize a test where you enable again the smart charging profile and I can check if it's limiting the session or not.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.

201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
